description: This PHP file defines the CalendarProviderTypeFactory class, a factory class responsible for creating instances of CalendarProviderType based on an input array. It includes a method fromArray that verifies the presence of required keys and constructs the object.

classes.name: CalendarProviderTypeFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for creating CalendarProviderType instances from an array of configuration data.

methods.name: fromArray
methods.description: Creates a CalendarProviderType instance from an array, validating required keys and casting the 'enabled' field to boolean.
